craft_notes: Sthāyin: so'ham (all lights mine). Rows: row 3 (undivided→He). Close: light (prabodhaprakāśaḥ as landing: beginningless waking light). Rejected: splitting the giant compound — kept whole-chain (one breath, the verse's own weight); 'I am That' — kept I-am-He (so'ham personal, not tat).

lines: Whatever lights abide in me, in highest heaven room-found,
shine in me eternal-famed, unparted — I am He:
unfeigned, eternal, unbroken-ruled, boundless, true, free,
dispelling the foe-pair's dark, nondual-not, beginningless waking-light.

reads_against.argmap: Who shines? → All lights mine, shining in me without division: so'ham as infinite true free dispeller of the foe-pair's darkness.
c1_essence: All lights in me, room-found in highest sky, shining undistinguished: I am He, infinite, true, free.
